description: N_m3u8DL-RE is a cross-platform command-line downloader for HLS (m3u8), DASH (mpd) and MSS streams. Handles AES-128/SAMPLE-AES/Widevine-supplied-key decryption, multi-track selection, live recording with real-time merge, and muxes output via mp4box/ffmpeg — the go-to tool for grabbing streaming media.
